displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EE6. The chart lists this during otherwise normal furnace operation
meaning: Flame sense microamp signal is low.
causes: Flame sensor positioned incorrectly in the burner
Lazy burner flame from improper gas pressure or combustion air
diySteps: The furnace may still be heating. Write down EE6
Technician: clean the flame sensor if it is coated or oxidized, check its alignment, check the inlet air piping, and compare gas pressure with the rating plate
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician to clean the flame sensor and check gas pressure before a low signal becomes a lockout.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
